question: Two angles of a triangle are \(50^\circ\) and \(60^\circ\). What is the third angle (unit: degrees)?
solution: The interior angles of a triangle sum to \(180^\circ\), so the third angle is \(180^\circ-50^\circ-60^\circ=70^\circ\).
